analysis.summaryJa: このページはabove・across・afterを固定訳ではなく、位置・基準・横断・広がり・時間順序・追跡という動きの図で整理する。さらにabove all、come across、look after、take after、name afterなど、中心イメージから派生した表現を業務文脈で見分ける。
grammarPoints: aboveは基準より高い位置・数値・順位を示す
above allは最優先事項を導く
acrossは面の横断・向かい側・範囲全体への広がりを示す
come acrossは偶然の発見を表す
afterは時間的な後・追跡・模倣や命名の由来を示す
visualEvidence: aboveの矢印が対象より高い位置と基準線超えを示す
acrossの矢印が面を一方から反対側へ横切る
地図上の複数地点への広がりがacrossの全域用法を示す
afterの矢印が先行する対象の後ろを追う
句動詞カードがcome acrossやtake afterへ意味が広がることを示す
commonTraps: aboveとonを接触の有無を見ずに混同する
acrossとthroughを面と内部の違いなく選ぶ
afterを時間の後だけと考え追跡・由来を見落とす
come acrossを語ごとに直訳する
after allとabove allを取り違える

questions.prompt: The emergency sign is mounted ------- the main exit.
questions.translationJa: 非常口の標識は正面出口の上方に取り付けられています。
questions.explanationJa: 接触を示さず、出口より高い位置にあるためaboveが適切です。

questions.prompt: The new branch performed well ------- the industry average last quarter.
questions.translationJa: 新支店の前四半期の業績は業界平均を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: 数値・基準を上回る意味ではabove the averageを使います。

questions.prompt: A covered walkway runs ------- the courtyard to the training center.
questions.translationJa: 屋根付き通路が中庭を横切って研修センターまで延びています。
questions.explanationJa: 一方の側から反対側へ横切る経路を表すためacrossです。

questions.prompt: The pharmacy is directly ------- the street from the hotel.
questions.translationJa: 薬局はホテルから通りを挟んだ真向かいにあります。
questions.explanationJa: across the street fromは『通りの向こう側に』という位置関係です。

questions.prompt: Customer satisfaction improved soon ------- the support desk extended its hours.
questions.translationJa: サポート窓口が営業時間を延長した後、顧客満足度はすぐ改善しました。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの出来事の時間順序を示すのでafterが適切です。

questions.prompt: The security officer ran ------- the visitor who had left a bag behind.
questions.translationJa: 警備員はかばんを置き忘れた来訪者を追いかけました。
questions.explanationJa: run afterは人を追う動きを表します。

questions.prompt: Above -------, please verify the client's account number before issuing a refund.
questions.translationJa: 何よりも、返金処理前に顧客の口座番号を確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: above allは優先順位を強める固定表現で『何よりも』です。

questions.prompt: The safety notice was distributed ------- all regional offices.
questions.translationJa: 安全通知は全地域事業所に広く配布されました。
questions.explanationJa: across＋複数範囲は『全体にわたって』という広がりを表します。

questions.prompt: The restaurant was named ------- the founder's hometown.
questions.translationJa: そのレストランは創業者の故郷にちなんで名付けられました。
questions.explanationJa: name A after Bで『BにちなんでAと名付ける』です。

questions.prompt: While reviewing archived email, I came ------- an earlier version of the contract.
questions.translationJa: 保存メールを確認中、私は契約書の以前の版を偶然見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: come acrossは『偶然見つける』という句動詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that places one floor higher than another.

choices.A: The executive lounge is across the conference hall upward.
choices.B: The executive lounge is above the conference hall.
choices.C: The executive lounge is after the conference hall vertically.
choices.D: The executive lounge is above to the conference hall.

questions.translationJa: 役員ラウンジは会議ホールの上階にあります。
questions.explanationJa: aboveは接触を含意せず、基準物より高い位置を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a result higher than a target.

choices.A: Monthly sales rose across the revised target.
choices.B: Monthly sales rose after the revised target upward.
choices.C: Monthly sales rose above the revised target.
choices.D: Monthly sales rose above to the revised target.

questions.translationJa: 月間売上は改訂目標を上回りました。
questions.explanationJa: 目標という基準線を超える意味ではaboveが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing movement from one side of a lobby to the other.

choices.A: The receptionist walked above the lobby floor to the other side.
choices.B: The receptionist walked after the lobby.
choices.C: The receptionist walked across to the lobby itself.
choices.D: The receptionist walked across the lobby.

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者はロビーを横切りました。
questions.explanationJa: across the lobbyは空間の一方から他方への横断を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a business on the opposite side of a road.

choices.A: A rental-car office is across the road from the station.
choices.B: A rental-car office is above the road from the station.
choices.C: A rental-car office is after the road from the station.
choices.D: A rental-car office is across from the road station.

questions.translationJa: レンタカー営業所は駅から道路を挟んだ向かい側にあります。
questions.explanationJa: across the road fromが向かい側の位置を正しく示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence showing that one event occurred later than another.

choices.A: We updated the brochure above the price change.
choices.B: We updated the brochure after the price change.
choices.C: We updated the brochure across the price change.
choices.D: We updated the brochure after to the price change.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは価格改定後にパンフレットを更新しました。
questions.explanationJa: afterは出来事の前後関係を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing pursuit.

choices.A: The attendant hurried above the passenger with the lost wallet.
choices.B: The attendant hurried across the passenger with the lost wallet.
choices.C: The attendant hurried after to the passenger with the lost wallet.
choices.D: The attendant hurried after the passenger with the lost wallet.

questions.translationJa: 係員は財布を落とした乗客を急いで追いかけました。
questions.explanationJa: hurry afterは対象を追う方向・目的を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving the highest priority.

choices.A: Across all, keep the emergency route clear.
choices.B: After all, keep the emergency route clear as the top priority only.
choices.C: Above all, keep the emergency route clear.
choices.D: Above every, keep the emergency route clear.

questions.translationJa: 何よりも、非常経路を空けておいてください。
questions.explanationJa: above allは最優先事項を提示します。after allは『結局』で意味が異なります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing company-wide adoption.

choices.A: The procedure is now used across the entire company.
choices.B: The procedure is now used above the entire company.
choices.C: The procedure is now used after the entire company.
choices.D: The procedure is now used across to the entire company.

questions.translationJa: その手順は現在、会社全体で使われています。
questions.explanationJa: across the entire companyは組織全体への広がりを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence saying a product received a person's name.

choices.A: The new model was named above its original designer.
choices.B: The new model was named after its original designer.
choices.C: The new model was named across its original designer.
choices.D: The new model was named after to its original designer.

questions.translationJa: 新型モデルは初代設計者にちなんで名付けられました。
questions.explanationJa: be named afterは『～にちなんで名付けられる』です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing an accidental discovery.

choices.A: We came above a useful supplier database.
choices.B: We came after a useful supplier database by appointment.
choices.C: We came across a useful supplier database.
choices.D: We came a useful supplier database across.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは有用な仕入先データベースを偶然見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: come acrossは分離できない句動詞で『偶然見つける』です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The temperature stayed above 20°C."

choices.A: The temperature moved across a room.
choices.B: The temperature was measured after 20 minutes.
choices.C: The temperature did not fall to 20°C or lower.

questions.translationJa: 気温は20度を下回りませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: above 20°Cは基準値20度より高い状態です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Her performance was above average."

choices.A: Her performance occurred across several offices.
choices.B: Her performance followed an average report.
choices.C: Her performance was below the usual level.
choices.D: Her performance was better than the typical level.

questions.translationJa: 彼女の実績は通常水準より良好でした。
questions.explanationJa: above averageは平均基準を上回ることです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The courier walked across the parking lot."

choices.A: The courier went from one side of the parking lot to the other.
choices.B: The courier remained above the parking lot.
choices.C: The courier walked only after the lot closed.
choices.D: The courier went around without entering the lot.

questions.translationJa: 配達員は駐車場の一方から反対側へ歩きました。
questions.explanationJa: acrossは面を横断する移動を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The café is across from the bank."

choices.A: The café is directly above the bank.
choices.B: The café is on the opposite side from the bank.
choices.C: The café opened after the bank.
choices.D: The café is inside the bank.

questions.translationJa: カフェは銀行の向かい側にあります。
questions.explanationJa: across fromは向かい合う位置関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The invoice arrived after the shipment."

choices.A: The invoice was placed above the shipment.
choices.B: The invoice crossed the shipment route.
choices.C: The shipment arrived first, and the invoice arrived later.
choices.D: Both arrived at exactly the same time.

questions.translationJa: 先に荷物が届き、その後で請求書が届きました。
questions.explanationJa: afterは時間順序で後を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The guard went after the intruder."

choices.B: The guard stood above the intruder.
choices.C: The guard walked across the intruder.
choices.D: The guard waited until after the intruder left.

questions.translationJa: 警備員は侵入者を追跡しました。
questions.explanationJa: go afterは対象を追う・追跡する意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Safety comes above convenience."

choices.A: Safety is physically located over convenience.
choices.D: Safety has a higher priority than convenience.

questions.translationJa: 安全は利便性より優先されます。
questions.explanationJa: 抽象的な順位でaboveは『より上位』を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The update was released across Europe."

choices.A: The update was released from a point above Europe.
choices.B: The update became available throughout Europe.
choices.C: The update was released only after Europe closed.
choices.D: The update crossed one European street.

questions.translationJa: 更新版は欧州全域で利用可能になりました。
questions.explanationJa: across Europeは広い地域全体への展開です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Ms. Ito takes after her former supervisor."

choices.A: Ms. Ito works later than her supervisor.
choices.C: Ms. Ito resembles her former supervisor in character or manner.
choices.D: Ms. Ito sits above her supervisor.

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは性格や振る舞いが以前の上司に似ています。
questions.explanationJa: take afterは人の性質・外見に似る意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I came across the memo yesterday."

choices.A: I found the memo by chance yesterday.
choices.B: I deliberately requested the memo yesterday.
choices.C: I placed the memo above another document.
choices.D: I read the memo only after yesterday.

questions.translationJa: 私は昨日そのメモを偶然見つけました。
questions.explanationJa: come acrossは予期せず発見することです。

questions.prompt: The screen is difficult to see from the back row. Please mount it ------- the speaker's podium.
questions.translationJa: 後列から画面が見にくいです。演台の上方に設置してください。
questions.explanationJa: 演台より高い位置を指定するためaboveです。

questions.prompt: The benchmark is 95 percent, and our latest inspection score was 98 percent. The score is ------- the required level.
questions.translationJa: 基準は95％で最新検査は98％でした。得点は要求水準を上回っています。
questions.explanationJa: 数値基準より高いのでabove the required levelです。

questions.prompt: The elevator is out of service. To reach the annex, walk ------- the glass bridge.
questions.translationJa: エレベーターは停止中です。別館へ行くにはガラス橋を渡ってください。
questions.explanationJa: 橋の一方から他方へ渡る移動なのでacrossです。

questions.prompt: Our office is not on this side of the avenue. It is ------- from the public library.
questions.translationJa: 当社オフィスは大通りのこちら側ではなく、公立図書館の向かい側です。
questions.explanationJa: across fromで向かい側の位置を示します。

questions.prompt: The revised warranty became effective on July 1. Claims filed ------- that date use the new form.
questions.translationJa: 改訂保証は7月1日に発効しました。その日より後の申請には新様式を使います。
questions.explanationJa: 基準日より後の時間を示すためafterです。

questions.prompt: A guest left her passport at reception and entered a taxi. The clerk ran ------- the taxi.
questions.translationJa: 来客が受付にパスポートを忘れてタクシーに乗りました。係員はタクシーを追いました。
questions.explanationJa: 動く対象を追跡するためrun afterを使います。

questions.prompt: The policy applies to headquarters and every overseas subsidiary. It has been adopted ------- the group.
questions.translationJa: 方針は本社と全海外子会社に適用されます。グループ全体で採用されています。
questions.explanationJa: 複数組織全体への広がりを表すacrossが適切です。

questions.prompt: The founder valued honesty more than rapid growth. ------- all, she told managers never to mislead customers.
questions.translationJa: 創業者は急成長より誠実さを重視しました。何より顧客を誤解させないよう管理職に伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 最重要点を導く定型句Above allが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: The hotel's new ballroom is called 'Sakura.' It was named ------- the trees in the courtyard.
questions.translationJa: ホテルの新宴会場は「Sakura」と呼ばれ、中庭の木々にちなんで名付けられました。
questions.explanationJa: 名称の由来を示すbe named afterを使います。

questions.prompt: No one was searching for the old warranty, but I found it while clearing a drawer. I came ------- it by accident.
questions.translationJa: 誰も古い保証書を探していませんでしたが、引き出し整理中に見つけました。偶然発見したのです。
questions.explanationJa: by accidentという手掛かりからcome acrossが適切です。
